source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.3.5 (PDF 216), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Apna idea achhi tarah pitch kar sakna is liye zaroori hai ke is se woh support (madad) milti hai jo idea ko haqeeqat banane ke liye chahiye. Chahe aap chhota karobar shuru kar rahe hon ya bara project, achhi pitch bohat bara farq dal sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: Business pitch ki ahmiyat samjhaiye (short question 5).
blocks.explanation: Pitch se idea ke liye zaroori paisa, partners aur customers milte hain: saaf aur qail karne wali pitch investors ko paisa lagane par, aur doosron ko madad karne ya khareedne par aamada karti hai.

items: Achhi pitch se support, investment aur customers milte hain.
